_about: Z13: zone mini-house object internals (furniture lists, placement, releasers, portals, effects, endurance, animations, emotions). Offsets are payload offsets. Layouts read in the 2016 zone code (house methods and InventoryLocking releasers) and checked against the 2016 client handlers; names from the 2017 PDB structs where they agree.

0x8c08.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_FUNICHERINVEN_CMD
fields: {u8 datasize, u16 location, SHINE_ITEM_STRUCT}; owner only

0x8c09.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_FUNICHER_CMD
fields: {u16 furniturehandle, u16 furnitureid, f32 x, f32 y, f32 z, f32 angle, u8 nEndureGrade}[n]

0x8c1f.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_REARRANGE_REQ
fields: {u16 furniturehandle, f32 x, f32 y, f32 z, f32 angle}[n]

0x8c20.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_REARRANGE_ACK
fields: 0x11C1 ok (from the releaser), 0x11CE DB refused (any furniture change), 0x11C6 / 0x11C7 / 0x11CB / 0x11CD / 0x11E0 / 0x11E1 / 0x11E2

0x8c21.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_REARRANGE_CMD
fields: always 1; the client reads only the first entry

0x8c22.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_CREATE_FURNITURE_REQ
fields: {u16 furniturehandle, f32 x, f32 y, f32 z, f32 angle}[n]

0x8c24.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_CREATE_FURNITURE_CMD
0x8c24.basis: zone FUN_0048a560 (and the portal of FUN_00573930); client FUN_0049b440

0x8c26.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_DELETE_FURNITURE_ACK
fields: 0x11C1 ok (from the releaser), 0x11C6 / 0x11C7 / 0x11CB / 0x11E0 / 0x11E1, 0x1DC2 dice removal reserved

0x8c27.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_DELETE_FURNITURE_CMD
fields: 1; the client reads only the first handle

0x8c3f.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_CHAR_ACTION_CMD
0x8c3f.basis: zone FUN_00574750 + mhoadb_GetAniData FUN_004a14c0; client FUN_0049b760
fields: follow-up animation: NextAniHandle, or a random member of the group NextAniHandle ≥ 10000; 0xFFFF none
1…ActorMaxNum random, 0 none; not read by the 2016 client
1…ActeeMaxNum random, 0 none; not read by the 2016 client

0x8c42.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_FURNITURE_EFFECT_CMD
fields: MiniHouseFurnitureObjEffect row index (client looks the row up by index)
players the effect was applied to (owner last)

0x8c58.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_PORTAL_EFFECT_CMD
0x8c58.basis: zone FUN_00574450 + FUN_00542c70; client ignores it
fields: Handle of the portal's ObjEffect row (1000+)

0x8c61.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_FURNITURE_ENDURE_CMD
fields: {u16 nFurnitureHnd, u8 nEndureGrade (MHE_STEP 0–4), u8 isRePair (1 after a repair kit; not read by the client)}

0x8c4c.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_PORTAL_ADD_CMD
fields: time_t, 0 = permanent; length 0xE leaves 6 stale bytes after it

0x8c4f.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_PORTAL_DEL_CMD
0x8c4f.basis: zone FUN_00567400 (so_Routine, owner only); client FUN_0049b870

0x8c64.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_FURNITURE_EMOTION_CMD
0x8c64.basis: zone FUN_00575850 (1 entry, broadcast) / FUN_005432d0 (all seated members, to the entering player); client FUN_004a5170
fields: {u16 nPlayerHandle, u16 nFurnitureHnd, u8 nPosition, u8 nEmotionNo}

0x8c67.name: NC_MINIHOUSE_FURNITURE_EMOTION_CANCEL_CMD
0x8c67.basis: zone FUN_00575ae0 (1 entry) / FUN_005431b0 (everybody on one furniture); client FUN_004a5230

0x348b.name: NC_ITEMDB_FURNITURE_ENDURE_REQ
0x348b.basis: zone UseItemFurnitureEndureKit::uivpb_ProtocolMake FUN_00596960 (+ CommonData by uib_AfterCast FUN_0059a530)
fields: old end extended by the kit's EffectValue hours, capped at now + Endure[0]
